Name: Nyapu-style Portraits for Seasonal Female Bachelors
Author: minka916
Description:
[color=#e69138][size=5]Known Issues:[/size][/color]
[line]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description][size=4]Seasonal Outfits:[/size][/url]
[/b]Harvey's mustache overlay turns Harriet into a nightmare creature.
You can fix this by setting "HarveyFacialHair" to False.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764][b][size=4]Seasonal Female Bachelors:[/size][/b][/url]
If you set "FestivalOutfits" to False [b]AND[/b] you use a specific hairpin color for Sam, the hairpin will render above Sam's hat during the [i]Ice Festival[/i] and [i]WinterStar[/i].
All other events/config combos and all portraits are unaffected.


[color=#e69138][size=5]Installation:[/size][/color]
[line]
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Mod Manager:[/size][/color][/b]
Install as usual. If you have problems make sure this mod loads [i]after[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764]Seasonal Female Bachelors[/url].

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Manual:[/size][/color][/b]
Extract and drop into Mods/, overwrite when asked.


[color=#e69138][size=5]Credits:[/size][/color]
[line]
[list]
[*]Original Portraits done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url].
[*]Outfit art and editing done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/minka916]Minka[/url].
[*]Content pack and patches by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SkettiSouls]SkettiSouls[/url].
[*]Outfits were based directly off the outfits by Ailin, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/46420462]IronZelly[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2816980]Alvadea[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].
[/list]
